title: Segment, target, position
caption: Marketing chooses who to serve before deciding what to say. Segments must be measurable, substantial, accessible and differentiable; positioning is the place the brand holds in customers' minds.
alt: Three boxes in order: segmentation, targeting, positioning, each with its options.
description: Segmentation: geographic, demographic, psychographic and behavioural bases.
Targeting: undifferentiated, differentiated, concentrated (niche) or micromarketing.
Positioning: the place a brand occupies in customers' minds relative to competitors.
